label: MiniMax M3.1 Flash
output:
**Subject:** Re: Nia's hen (just us two – not on the group)

Hiya Beth,

Right, I'm not doing this on the group thread, I'll keep it between us.

Fair enough, it's a mess and I'd be lying if I said it wasn't. But I'm going to try you once more and if you say no again I'll leave it alone, promise.

The thing is, Nia rang me last week, in tears, asking if you were still coming. She doesn't know you've pulled out. And in 2019 you sat with her in the Heath every night when your mam was bad — she wasn't going anywhere, she just needed people. So the wedding's 17th April at Margam, you're doing the reading, that's the wedding. This is her hen and she wants you in the room.

What happened at Lowri's 40th in November went both ways. You both said things, that's how it goes after a few drinks. Lowri's about as stubborn as you are and I reckon she's as sorry as you are, but neither of you will go first. I'm not taking sides, honestly. I just don't want a stupid row to be the reason Nia's hen is half empty.

Could you come for Saturday only? Skip the cottage Friday completely, that's the bit I don't even like. Train from Cardiff Central gets you in about 2.5 hours, I'll come and pick you up from the station, and you've got the twin room with me on Saturday night so no hotel. It's the meal at Caffi Harbwr, 7.30, that's the bit that matters, that's Nia's actual thing. And Nia won't know which year you are, that's the whole point of the surprise, so no pressure there.

One more thing – don't send Lowri the £85 yet. I've paid mine and I'd rather it got sorted properly than you paying money into the middle of a row. If you come for Saturday I'll cover it and we can square up later.

Also, I've swapped my Orlando trip with Kerry from work to get this weekend off, cost me a night stop I was really gutted about, but I'd still do it again for this.

I've only just landed off a flight from Lagos so my head's mush, forgive the rambling. Say yes to Saturday?

Siân x

reasons: Leaves out that Beth only needs to reach Tenby by 6 on Saturday, and never says Beth will regret missing it or that Nia will remember who wasn't there.
